Package com.vectorpeaks.backend.repository

Interface ChatRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<Chat,Integer>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Chat,Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<Chat,Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<Chat,Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<Chat,Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<Chat>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Chat,Integer>
public interface ChatRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Chat,Integer>
Repository interface for performing CRUD operations on Chat entities. Extends Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository to provide standard database access methods. Includes a derived query for participant lookup and a custom query for direct chat deduplication.

    • findDirectChat

      @Query("SELECT c FROM Chat c\nJOIN c.participants p1\nJOIN c.participants p2\nWHERE p1.id = :userId1 AND p2.id = :userId2\nAND SIZE(c.participants) = 2\n") Optional<Chat> findDirectChat(@Param("userId1") Integer userId1, @Param("userId2") Integer userId2)
      Checks whether a direct (two-participant) chat already exists between two specific users. Used when opening a new conversation to avoid creating duplicate chat threads. A custom @Query is required here because the logic depends on both participant IDs and an exact participant count of two.
      Parameters:
      userId1 - the ID of the first user
      userId2 - the ID of the second user
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the existing chat, or empty if none found
